meta.identityRole: Identify each observed brand in CityMETER Luxury Brands store pins, lists and details
meta.transformation: Original approved logo bytes embedded unchanged as SVG image data URI; deterministic viewport trim of transparent or solid-neutral outer whitespace only with safety margin. Added UI backing is LDS surface-soft stone #E5E9E6 for 139 transparent-source marks, original white #FFFFFF for 13 opaque-white sources, and dark #182327 for 16 marks requiring dark backing. No source image recoloring, inversion, ink cropping or tracing.
